resources.label: European Observatory of Wildlife Results Database (public v13)
resources.scope: European multi-site camera based REM density summaries and public protocol
released_contents: EOW_database.xlsx: policy, site metadata, site-year summaries, legend
resources.critical_reason: Photogrammetry protocol and site/year summaries do not establish deployment-linked raw trigger, missed reference passage and actual camera/reference uptime observations.
resources.next_input_if_offered: Original event/deployment table, stable physical station-to-device crosswalk, raw calibration/ranging reference tied to deployment, and synchronized independent reference passage intervals.

resources.label: SmartWilds metadata and 2026-11-08 camera release
resources.scope: The Wilds conservation facility, Ohio, USA, one source/geographic region in summer 2025
released_contents: Camera records, corrected times and model-label provenance
Co-located acoustic recorders at a subset of sites, drone flights and visitor records
resources.critical_reason: Co-located audio, flights and corrected clock timestamps are not an independently complete census of animals that never triggered a camera; source documents also flag major clock repairs and irrecoverable true deployment-times for some cameras.
resources.next_input_if_offered: Synchronized continuous or randomized independent reference coverage of exact focal camera zones with verified reference sensitivity, camera/reference operating overlap and traceable missed passages at geographically crossed sites.

resources.label: Qilian Mountains Desert Steppe camera events
resources.scope: 22 infrared cameras in one region, Dec 2020-Jan 2022, published independent-event time-filtered records
released_contents: Camera effort and georeferenced station documentation
Temporal-threshold-filtered wildlife detections, manually annotated and reviewed
resources.critical_reason: An independent event is an interval-declustered camera detection, not an independently observed camera miss. Single-region observations cannot satisfy E5 cross-geography source crossing.
resources.next_input_if_offered: A second crossed region/protocol with an independent reference passage, camera uptime and focal zone crosswalk.

preferred_independent_passage_route_requ: stable physical station and deployment-to-device identity; no reuse of hardware ID as a station
multiple independent regional replicates and sites with fixed closed observation windows
timestamped, known camera and independent-reference operating overlap intervals
non-camera-trigger-selected reference passages including known focal-camera misses, with reference sensitivity assessed
crossed geography x sensor or protocol design and untouched geographic holdout
at least six distinct exposure calendar months for training AND holdout under the original E5 contract
